Name: Calgary International Airport
Description: Fly in Aug 18, 2026. Pick up one-way SUV here for Calgary to Vancouver route.

Name: Canmore / Dead Man's Flats base
Description: Nights 1-3 (Aug 18-21). Use Canmore if Airbnb availability and pricing work; Dead Man's Flats is acceptable but less walkable and adds 10-15 minutes for meals and errands. Base for Banff Gondola, Johnston Canyon, Moraine Lake, and Lake Louise.

Name: Dead Man's Flats
Description: Backup/alternate Banff-area lodging if Canmore Airbnb options are poor. Plan groceries and dinners by car; do not assume walkable Canmore-style evenings.

Name: Golden
Description: Night 4 (Aug 21-22). Best logistics for Yoho, Emerald Lake, Natural Bridge, and Golden Skybridge before continuing to Jasper via the Icefields Parkway.

Name: Jasper townsite
Description: Nights 5-6 (Aug 22-24). Base for Maligne Lake Spirit Island Cruise, Pyramid Lake, Jasper town, and optional local recovery stops. Book direct early due to tight post-wildfire accommodation supply.

Name: Kamloops
Description: Night 7 (Aug 24-25). Practical break between Jasper and Whistler. Use for fuel, food, laundry, and rest before the scenic Lillooet/Duffey Lake drive.

Name: Whistler
Description: Night 8 (Aug 25-26). Base for Peak 2 Peak / Whistler alpine sightseeing, village time, Lost Lake, and Valley Trail.

Name: Vancouver
Description: Night 9 (Aug 26-27). Final night before YVR departure; protects the flight day from Sea-to-Sky traffic or rental-return delays.

Name: Vancouver International Airport
Description: Fly out Aug 27, 2026. Return one-way SUV here; allow buffer for rental return and check-in.
